content_html:
its been almost 5 days since Adipurush released and No doubt it was a badly made film but few of the opinions shared on internet by so called intellectuals really baffle me:

OPINION # 1 : it was one party’s ploy to cash on Shri Ram’s sentiment and they have put money and took ownership of the movie as they can sell their agenda in the name of God and make money and the money made will eventually be used for upcoming elections….and audience (apart from Andh bakths) outrightly rejected this ploy though Bakths are putting all their efforts to make this agenda movie a block buster!!!

MY COUTER for above OPINION : I really wonder if those who have above opinion have really watched this movie 🤷🏻‍♂️ because if the said party had got involved then there was no way this movie would have made with such standards where even an orthodox religious person would also for a second thought of becoming an atheist 🤣

OPINION # 2 : it was Bollywood alias Urduwoods ploy along with Anti Nationals and Liberandus to spoil the Epic Ramayana and thus degrade Hindus all over the world…..and luckily the true Hindus (read Bhakts) have understood their ploy and have expressed their voice against this movie which showed our epic in very light

MY COUTER for above OPINION : this is bullshit as at this moment where even opposition leader is also visiting each and every temple for blessings there is no way the Liberal party’s take the risk of portraying Hindu culture in bad light especially when Elections are due next year 🙏

MY OPINION on this Movie:

lets first talk about the official Producers of this movie –

T-Series : if we just rewind back ourselves to our childhood days in early and mid 90’s we will remember that Gulshan Kumar the founder of T-Series was famous for his Bakthi Songs on all Hindu Gods and Goddesses….and hence its pretty evident that T-Series was always a part of making Religious content and they have done it in the past with no tag of being Bakths of any party!!!!

and also if we look at our Television or Movie history, for every generation or two the epic tales of Ramayana and Mahabharata were remade with latest technology available to reach out to the current generation of audience….and we have multiple variations of Mahabaratha being told on TV (some of them were popular, some were average and some were disaster)

but post Sampoorna Ramayana and later Animation version in early 90’s….Ramayana was never re-told and a project on Ramayana was long due

May be with the Ram Mandir construction, T-Series might have thought its the best time to re-narrate Ramayana!!!

and now coming to its Director: Om Rauth has won National Award for his previous film Tanajji which has shown significant part of Maharashtrian history….and hence T-Series might have thought he could handle the movie well

and when they wanted to tell this story on large scale obviously large amount was invested and to recover the budgets they needed a face who could bring them collections from all over India….and with Bahubali, there was no other option apart from Prabhas and they have blindly took him with a hope to recover budgets irrespective of whether he fits in the role or not

so far so good……but the major failure was the execution part where the team was unable to handle such high CGI as well as were left in dilemma on how to convey this story to this modern age audience who are more independent and question the loopholes irrespective of whether the loopholes are in the Epics itself…and hence they tried to come up with their own version of Ramayana and that has back fired a lot!!!!

now who am I and on what basis am I sharing my opinion…..I am neither a Bakth nor an Anti National!!! I am neither Religious nor an Atheist!!! I am neither an hardcore Prabhas fan nor do I hate him!!! I equally loved as well as hated various movies from Bollywood purely based on their content not on their intent 😊…..I am just APOLITICAL MOVIE BUFF!!!!
